#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replay review navigation in a drive instance with a synthetic store and repositories."""

import argparse
from contextlib import closing
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts/diff-scroll'))
from run import evaluate, request, save, until

sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts/interaction-performance'))
from processes import stop_app

FIXTURE = ROOT / 'scripts/interaction-performance/fixture.py'
fixture_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('interaction_fixture', FIXTURE)
fixture_module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(fixture_spec)
fixture_spec.loader.exec_module(fixture_module)

ARCHIVE = 'Synthetic archived review'
CONTROL = 'Synthetic control review'
OTHER_CONTROL = 'Synthetic other repository review'
TARGET = 'review-thread-12'
ORPHAN = 'review-thread-14'
STAMP = 1_700_001_000


def seed_store(data, repository, commits, other_repository, other_head):
    schema = (ROOT / 'src-tauri/review/src/reviewdb/schema.rs').read_text()
    migrations = dict(re.findall(r'const V(\d+): &str = r"\n(.*?)\n";', schema, re.S))
    version = int(re.search(r'CURRENT_VERSION: i64 = (\d+);', schema)[1])
    assert version == 16, 'Recheck the fixture inserts against the new review schema'
    anchors = {}
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(data / 'reviews.db')) as store, store:
        for migration in range(1, version + 1):
            store.executescript(migrations[str(migration)])
        store.execute(f'PRAGMA user_version = {version}')
        store.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON')
        store.executemany('INSERT INTO reviews VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', [
            ('control', str(repository), CONTROL, STAMP, STAMP, 0),
            ('archive', str(repository), ARCHIVE, STAMP + 1, STAMP + 1, 1),
            ('other-control', str(other_repository), OTHER_CONTROL, STAMP, STAMP, 0),
        ])
        store.executemany('INSERT INTO active_review VALUES (?, ?)', [
            (str(repository), 'control'), (str(other_repository), 'other-control'),
        ])
        store.execute('''INSERT INTO threads
            (id, review_id, body, channel, state, anchor_kind, commit_oid, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES ('other-control-thread', 'other-control', 'Other repository fixture', 'human', 'open', 'commit', ?, ?, ?)''',
            (other_head, STAMP, STAMP))
        store.execute('''INSERT INTO threads
            (id, review_id, body, channel, state, anchor_kind, commit_oid, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES ('control-thread', 'control', 'Control fixture only', 'human', 'open', 'commit', ?, ?, ?)''',
            (commits[2], STAMP, STAMP))
        for n in range(15):
            thread = f'review-thread-{n:02}'
            revision = 2 if n < 10 else 1
            path = f'file-{n % 10:04}.ts' if thread != ORPHAN else 'retired.ts'
            line = 20 + n
            marker = f'file {n % 10} revision {revision} line {line - 1}'
            excerpt = f'+export const value{line - 1} = "{marker}";'
            anchors[thread] = {'path': path, 'line': line, 'marker': marker,
                               'oid': commits[revision], 'side': 'New'}
            store.execute('''INSERT INTO threads
                (id, review_id, body, channel, state, stale, anchor_kind, commit_oid, file_path,
                 source, side, start_line, end_line, excerpt, created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, 'archive', ?, 'human', ?, ?, 'diff', ?, ?, 'Diff', 'New', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)''',
                (thread, f'Synthetic discussion {n:02}', 'open' if n % 3 or thread == TARGET else 'done',
                 int(thread == ORPHAN), commits[revision], path, line, line, excerpt, STAMP + n, STAMP + n))
            if n < 9 or thread == TARGET:
                for reply in range(2):
                    reply_stamp = STAMP + n + reply + 30
                    store.execute('''INSERT INTO replies
                        (id, thread_id, body, channel, created_at, updated_at, seen)
                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)''',
                        (f'{thread}-reply-{reply}', thread, f'Synthetic reply {reply} to discussion {n:02}',
                         'agent' if reply == 0 else 'human', reply_stamp, reply_stamp,
                         int(thread != TARGET or reply != 0)))
        assert not list(store.execute('PRAGMA foreign_key_check'))
    return anchors


def fixtures(directory):
    primary = directory / 'review-repo'
    secondary = directory / 'other-repo'
    commits = fixture_module.create_fixture(primary, 10, 96)
    other_commits = fixture_module.create_fixture(secondary, 1, 12)
    data = directory / 'data'
    data.mkdir()
    save(data / 'trunk-prefs.json', {
        'open_tabs': [{'id': path.name, 'repoPath': str(path), 'repoName': path.name}
                      for path in (primary, secondary)],
        'active_tab_id': primary.name,
        'fetch_interval_ms': 0,
    })
    return data, seed_store(data, primary, commits, secondary, other_commits[2])


def wait_for_socket(directory, app):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 25
    while not (directory / 'listening').exists():
        if app.poll() is not None:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Drive process exited {app.returncode} before readiness')
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            raise RuntimeError('Drive listening socket never became ready')
        time.sleep(0.05)


def run(binary, output, expected):
    output.mkdir()
    scenario = (HERE / 'scenario-tightened.js').read_bytes()
    with binary.open('rb') as executable:
        binary_digest = hashlib.file_digest(executable, 'sha256').hexdigest()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='trunk-review-replay-', dir='/tmp') as scratch:
        directory = Path(scratch).resolve()
        data, anchors = fixtures(directory)
        save(output / 'fixture.json', {
            'binary': str(binary), 'binarySha256': binary_digest, 'archivedThreads': 15,
            'archivedReplies': 20, 'controlThreads': 1, 'target': anchors[TARGET],
            'orphan': ORPHAN, 'checkoutHead': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'],
                                                                     cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
            'scenarioSha256': hashlib.sha256(scenario).hexdigest(),
            'secondaryControl': {'review': OTHER_CONTROL, 'thread': 'other-control-thread'},
            'expected': expected,
        })
        environment = {**os.environ, 'TRUNK_DRIVE_DIR': str(directory), 'TRUNK_DATA_DIR': str(data)}
        with (output / 'app.log').open('w') as log:
            app = subprocess.Popen([str(binary)], env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=log)
            try:
                wait_for_socket(directory, app)
                until(directory, 'window.__trunkDrive.list("button").includes("Review")')
                evaluate(directory, scenario.decode())
                inputs = json.dumps({'target': TARGET, 'orphan': ORPHAN, 'anchor': anchors[TARGET]})
                try:
                    result = evaluate(directory, f'window.reviewReplay.replay({inputs})')
                finally:
                    save(output / 'observations.json', evaluate(directory, 'window.reviewReplay.observations'))
                result['expectedTabReturn'] = expected
                save(output / 'result.json', result)
            finally:
                stop_app(app, lambda: request(directory, {'op': 'quit'}))
    assert not directory.exists(), f'Temporary replay directory remains at {directory}'
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2), flush=True)
    if result['tabReturnVerdict'] != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f"Expected {expected}; observed {result['tabReturnVerdict']}")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('binary', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('output', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--expect', choices=('reset', 'preserved'), default='preserved')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    run(args.binary.resolve(strict=True), args.output.resolve(), args.expect)

protocol.functional: Start a drive window with A active. Open Review, expand Archived, and select Synthetic archived review. Record the 15 rendered thread IDs and check the missing-file badge. Focus the review region, take J to thread 12, and check K then J return to that thread. Press Enter, confirm the exact commit SHA prefix, added-side line, source sentinel, and inline thread DOM. Click Close diff and read the distinctive review title, the card cursor and focus, and scrollTop after two animation frames. Switch A to B to A by clicking the tabs. Repeat the same reading after the archive is ready and check where the first J goes.
protocol.warmSelection: In a separate drive instance, open the active review and expand Archived. Warm both review selections. Alternate selecting the archive and selecting the active control for three pairs. Read performance.now() in the page immediately before the review row click and once the requested title, exact card count and a laid-out sentinel card are observed. A laid-out card may be below the viewport.
protocol.admission: Baseline functional and readiness runs used separate serial launches. The native window was coordinated after the integrated checks and picker capture ended. Entry and exit executable and argument snapshots screened build and test activity. Receipts retain digests and verdicts. Activity entirely between snapshots can escape detection.

excludedPilots: functional-1 stopped at a reply insert binding error before the app launched.
functional-2 used the wrong badge label predicate and timed out at the orphan check.
functional-3 targeted a settled thread folded by default and did not reach the jump.
functional-4 reproduced the tab reset and diff return but did not assert a SHA prefix or read the added-side line number. The final replay adds both assertions.

protocol.functional: Select the archive in A and match the exact set of 15 thread IDs. Use J, K and Enter on thread 12. Match the exact seven-character SHA, path, added-line label and complete code marker. The target card must be in the adjacent inline row, with both code and card inside the clipped diff viewport. Close diff must preserve the cursor, actual card focus, scroll offset, relative card offset and expanded archive. B must display its own review with only its own sentinel thread. protocol.verdict: The runner succeeds only when the tab-return outcome matches --expect. Use reset for the baseline, preserved for the candidate. Diff, diff-return and B-control checks must pass under either expectation.
